name: Pairwise Position Scoring
description: Replaces the Hamming weight and distance equation with a custom position-wise scoring function F(S_i, S_j). By assigning a score of 3 when both bits are 1 and 1 otherwise, the sum over all m positions simplifies algebraically to m + 2*c_ij (where c_ij is the number of shared 1s). The resonance equation becomes F(a,b)+F(b,c)+F(c,a) = 3m+6, strictly equivalent to finding a triangle. This completely hides the graph degree/distance mapping that pattern-matching models rely on, while allowing reasoning models to algebraically reduce it.
